name: Fallen
source:
A short visual novel about the events leading up to Cherub becoming a fallen angel, and about the human that set it all in motion.

[From [url=https://cheruboki.itch.io/fallen] Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
基路伯是如何一步步成为堕天使的？又是怎样一个人类让这一切开始的？这部短篇视觉小说讲述的就是他们的故事。

［摘自[url=https://cheruboki.itch.io/fallen]Itch.io[/url]］
